title: Teacher picks one of the compared approaches and asks to continue with it
turnSequence: After a comparison of approaches, the teacher selects one approach (for example, number-line first).
The app should continue generation scoped to the chosen approach and record the choice.
expected: A recorded approach choice scopes the subsequent generation and survives a retry or page state.
observableFailure: The choice cannot be recorded, or generation ignores it and drafts the same fixed four variants regardless.
flipCondition: Unblocks when an approach-comparison stage exists in the generation workflow and a chosen approach can be recorded and honored.
